sections.html:
anxious

(adjective). bồn chồn, lo lắng

Ex: I felt very anxious and depressed about the future.

aristocracy

(noun). tầng lớp quý tộc

Ex: Classes are obvious - there were the aristocracy, the middle class or bourgeois, and of course the peasantry or rustic class.

claim

(noun). lời tuyên bố

Ex: The company had made false claims about its products.

co-opt

(verb). lựa chọn làm thành viên

Ex: She was co-opted onto the board.

commission

(verb). ủy nhiệm, ủy thác

Ex: The survey on consumer taste was commissioned by local stores.

curate

(verb). Phụ trách (nhà bảo tàng...)

Ex: She curated a recent exhibition of Indian artwork.

display

(noun). sự phô bày, sự trưng bày

Ex: She slammed the door behind her in a display of ill-temper.

entrepreneur

(noun). Doanh nhân, người khởi nghiệp

Ex: He’s an entrepreneur who made his money in computer software.

faint

(adjective). mờ, không rõ

Ex: We saw the faint outline of the mountain through the mist.

grand

(adjective). lớn lao

Ex: The wedding was a very grand occasion.

humble

(adjective). khiêm tốn

Ex: The company has worked its way up from humble beginnings to become the market leader.

interior

(noun). phần bên trong

Ex: The original interior of the hotel has been replaced.

mobility

(noun). tính lưu động

Ex: The high cost of living acts as an obstacle to mobility of labour.

mount

(verb). sắp xếp, tổ chức

Ex: Residents mounted a campaign to fight the plans.

neoclassical

(adjective). tân cổ điển

Ex: The play is done in a neoclassical ballet style with motifs and elements of the argentine tango.

permanent

(adjective). Lâu dài

Ex: She was unable to find a permanent job.

plainly

(adverb). một cách rõ ràng, một cách hiển nhiên

Ex: The men had plainly lied.

precise

(adjective). Chính xác

Ex: Can you give a more precise definition of the word?

principal

(adjective). chính, chủ yếu

Ex: Ex: My principal concern is to get the job done fast.

promising

(adjective). Đầy hứa hẹn, có tiềm năng

Ex: The research produced promising results.

prosperous

(adjective). thịnh vượng, thành công

Ex: Farmers are more prosperous in the south of the country.

renowned

(adjective). lừng danh

Ex: We asked for advice from the renowned legal expert, Sam Pincher.

uncompromising

(adjective). không khoan nhượng

Ex: He has a reputation for being tough and uncompromising.

overcrowded

(adjective). quá đông người

Ex: Too many poor people are living in overcrowded conditions.

renovate

(verb). Cải tạo

Ex: They spent the summer renovating a farmhouse in Kent.

stage

(verb). sắp xếp, tổ chức, đưa (vở kịch..) lên sân khấu

Ex: The local theatre group is staging a production of ‘Hamlet’.

exhibition

(noun). Triển lãm

Ex: The gallery is hosting an exhibition of his work.

alternately

(adverb). luân phiên

Ex: The film is alternately depressing and amusing.

bold

(adjective). rõ nét, đậm nét

Ex: The furniture was painted in bold, primary colours.

elegant

(adjective). thanh thoát, tao nhã

Ex: This is a fine building of elegant proportions.

facade

(noun). mặt trước

Ex: The design of the building facades illustrates the approach we took toward construction cost control.

mixture

(noun). Hỗn hợp

Ex: Anger is often caused by frustration or embarrassment, or a mixture of the two.

represent

(verb). thể hiện

Ex: Those comments do not represent the views of us all.

rustication

(noun). sự mộc mạc

Ex: He had become accustomed to rustication in Blairgowrie, where the locals call him Bill.

trademark

(noun). thương hiệu, nhãn hiệu

Ex: ‘Big Mac’ is McDonald's best-known trademark.

typically

(adverb). điển hình

Ex: It is a quiet, typically Dutch town, with its old brick houses and tree-bordered canals

pediment

(noun). trán tường hình tam giác

Ex: They followed the classic model of Greek temples, with their rectangular rows of columns, topped by beams and relieved by a triangular pediment.

miller

(noun). Chủ cối xay, thợ phay

Ex: He is a miller at Nelstrops flour mill in Stockport, where he has worked for nearly 30 years.

settle

(verb). định cư, ổn điịnh cuộc sống

Ex: He has now settled permanently in London.

architect

(noun). Kiến trúc sư

Ex: The house was designed by architect Louis Kahn.

architectural

(adjective). thuộc về kiến trúc

Ex: Wootton Bassett has retained much of its architectural heritage.

organise

(verb). tổ chức, sắp xếp

Ex: He helped to organize various events.

refuse

(verb). từ chối

Ex: She refused to accept that there was a problem.

landowner

(noun). điền chủ

Ex: In areas that are privately owned, the council encourages the landowners to keep their land free from litter.

patron

(noun). Người bảo trợ; khách hàng

Ex: He was a great patron of the arts and helped to establish the Baltimore Museum.

scholar

(noun). học giả

Ex: He was the most distinguished scholar in his field.

alternative

(adjective). khác

Ex: The road was closed so we had to find an alternative route.

base on

(verb). dựa vào

Ex: What are you basing this theory on?

bear a resemblance to

(verb). giống với

Ex: She bears a striking resemblance to her older sister.

offer

(verb). Cung cấp

Ex: The hotel offers excellent facilities for families.

uncanny

(adjective). kỳ lạ, kỳ quặc

Ex: I had an uncanny feeling I was being watched.

alienate

(verb). làm cho xa lánh

Ex: His comments have alienated a lot of young voters.

critic

(noun). nhà phê bình

Ex: The critics loved the movie.

unreconstructed

(adjective). không thay đổi

Ex: She describes herself as an unreconstructed feminist.

wealthy

(adjective). giàu

Ex: The deal is about to make him a very wealthy man.

client

(noun). khách hàng

Ex: She's a well-known lawyer with many famous clients.

contain

(verb). Chứa đựng, bao gồm

Ex: This drink doesn't contain any alcohol.

leaven

(verb). làm sôi nổi hẳn lên

Ex: Her speech was leavened with a touch of humour.

portrait

(noun). Chân dung

Ex: It was said that the portrait was a very true likeness of her.

major

(adjective). chủ yếu, quan trọng

Ex: He played a major role in setting up the system.

apprentice

(verb). cho học việc

Ex: He was apprenticed to his uncle as a carpenter.

arrange

(verb). sắp xếp

Ex: Can I arrange an appointment for Monday?

classical

(adjective). cổ điển, kinh điển

Ex: the classical theory of unemployment Ex: This piece is also the furthest from the traditional style of classical ballet and offers a good reflection of the state of contemporary ballet.

influential

(adjective). có tầm ảnh hưởng

Ex: She is one of the most influential figures in local politics.

masterpiece

(noun). tuyệt tác

Ex: Leonardo's "Last Supper" is widely regarded as a masterpiece.

disciple

(noun). đồ đệ, môn đồ

Ex: These ideas are central to the work of Freud and his disciples.

foreign

(adjective). nước ngoài

Ex: What foreign languages do you speak?

influence

(verb). ảnh hưởng

Ex: His film is heavily influenced by other film-makers.

ancient

(adjective). cổ đại

Ex: People have lived in this valley since ancient times.

approach

(verb). Tiếp cận, đến gần

Ex: We could hear the train approaching.

rural

(adjective). Thuộc khu vực miền quê

Ex: He grew up in a predominantly rural area.

urban

(adjective). Thuộc về khu vực thành thị

Ex: Pollution has reached disturbingly high levels in some urban areas.

illustrate

(verb). Minh hoạ

Ex: He is showing these silent films to help illustrate his story of survival.

nurture

(verb). nuôi dưỡng

Ex: It's important to nurture a good working relationship.

reputation

(noun). danh tiếng

Ex: The company enjoys an international reputation for quality of design.

strengthen

(verb). củng cố, tăng cường

Ex: The new manager has strengthened the side by bringing in several younger players.

benevolent

(adjective). nhân từ, nhân đức

Ex: He is generally viewed as a benevolent figure in history.

harmonious

(adjective). Hài hoà, cân đối

Ex: All the buildings on the campus are architecturally harmonious.

impact

(noun). tác động

Ex: Her speech made a profound impact on everyone.

impart

(verb). Truyền đạt

Ex: I was rather quiet as I didn't feel I had much wisdom to impart on the subject.

proportion

(noun). Tỷ lệ

Ex: The proportion of regular smokers increases with age.

sections.title: Passage 2: Corporate Social Responsibility
sections.html:
appeal

(noun). Sự kêu gọi; lời kêu gọi

Ex: He made an emotional appeal to voters.

arise

(verb). xuất hiện

Ex: We keep them informed of any changes as they arise.

assess

(verb). đánh giá

Ex: It's difficult to assess the effects of these changes.

bear

(verb). chịu đựng

Ex: The pain was almost more than he could bear.

broadly

(adverb). 1 cách bao quát

Ex: Broadly speaking, I agree with you.

commercial

(adjective). mang tính thương mại

Ex: She is developing the commercial side of the organization.

compromise

(verb). làm hại

Ex: Alcohol and drug abuse can compromise your health, not to mention your life.

constituency

(noun). nhóm người ủng hộ

Ex: There is a strong constituency of support for his proposal.

content

(adjective). bằng lòng

Ex: He had to be content with third place.

corporate

(adjective). thuộc đoàn thể

Ex: All adults take corporate responsibility for the upbringing of the tribe's children.

currently

(adverb). tại thời điểm hiện tại

Ex: All the options are currently available.

enliven

(verb). làm sinh động

Ex: The game was much enlivened when both teams scored within five minutes of each other.

enrollment

(noun). sự kết nạp, sự nhận vào

Ex: Fees must be paid in full at the time of enrolment.

entirely

(adverb). hoàn toàn

Ex: The experience was entirely new to me.

equip

(verb). trang bị

Ex: The centre is well equipped for canoeing and mountaineering.

ethical

(adjective). thuộc về đạo đức

Ex: Is it ethical to keep animals in zoos?

expertise

(noun). Chuyên môn

Ex: We have the expertise to help you run your business.

exploitation

(noun). sự lạm dụng, sự khai thác

Ex: Starvation and poverty are the result of global economic exploitation, not lack of resources.

gradually

(adverb). dần dần

Ex: Over the next three weeks, the effect gradually returned.

humane

(adjective). nhân đạo

Ex: Campaigners claim that the animals are not being kept in humane conditions.

inherently

(adverb). vốn có, vốn đã

Ex: She felt that the system was inherently unfair and unequal.

institution

(noun). Tổ chức, viện

Ex: Harvard University is an internationally respected institution.

moral

(adjective). thuộc về đạo đức

Ex: She felt she had a moral duty to look after her elderly parents.

morale

(noun). nhuệ khí, tinh thần, chí khí

Ex: Morale amongst the players is very high at the moment.

obligation

(noun). Nghĩa vụ

Ex: She did not feel under any obligation to tell him the truth.

outdated

(adjective). lỗi thời

Ex: It is an outdated and inefficient system.

passionate

(adjective). đầy đam mê

Ex: His guitar playing was passionate and extremely skilful.

philanthropy

(noun). từ thiện

Ex: Hospitals were built as a result of private philanthropy and government intervention.

potentially

(adverb). có triển vọng

Ex: This crisis is potentially the most serious in the organization's history.

prominent

(adjective). nổi bật

Ex: The church tower was a prominent feature in the landscape.

proponent

(noun). người ủng hộ

Ex: She is among the most outspoken proponents of the plan.

reputation

(noun). danh tiếng

Ex: The company enjoys an international reputation for quality of design.

retention

(noun). sự giữ lại

Ex: The company needs to improve its training and retention of staff.

stake

(noun). tiền dấn vốn

Ex: IBM will take an 18 per cent ownership stake in the new company.

stewardship

(noun). sự quản lí

Ex: The organization certainly prospered under his stewardship.

sustainability

(noun). tính bền vững

Ex: The strength and sustainability of the economic recovery is still in doubt.

vast

(adjective). rộng lớn

Ex: In the vast majority of cases, this should not be a problem.

account for

(verb). giải thích cho

Ex: How do you account for the show's success?

address

(verb). giải quyết

Ex: The policy fails to address the needs of the poor.

derive

(verb). bắt nguồn từ

Ex: The story derives from a very common folktale.

justify

(verb). biện minh, chứng minh là đúng

Ex: Her success had justified the faith her teachers had put in her.

motivate

(verb). Khuyến khích, tạo động lực

Ex: What motivates people to carry out such attacks?

notion

(noun). khái niệm

Ex: She had only a vague notion of what might happen.

operate

(verb). Vận hành

Ex: Solar panels can only operate in sunlight.

permission

(noun). sự cho phép

Ex: No official permission has been given for the event to take place.

priority

(noun). sự ưu tiên

Ex: Education is a top priority.

resource

(noun). Nguồn tài nguyên

Ex: They promote the use of renewable resources like soybean oil.

company

(noun). công ty

Ex: It is the world's largest software company.

consequence

(noun). Hậu quả

Ex: Remember that actions have consequences.

impact

(noun). tác động

Ex: Her speech made a profound impact on everyone.

government

(noun). chính phủ

Ex: She is the government official in charge of the project.

advance

(verb). thúc đẩy, làm cho tiến bộ

Ex: Studying for new qualifications is one way of advancing your career.

innovation

(noun). Đổi mới, cải tiến

Ex: The company is very interested in product design and innovation.

productive

(adjective). hiệu suất tốt

Ex: My time spent in the library was very productive.

property

(noun). Tài sản

Ex: This building is government property.

pursue

(verb). Theo đuổi

Ex: She wishes to pursue a medical career.

regulatory

(adjective). thuộc về quản lí, thuộc về điều tiết

Ex: The deal is subject to regulatory approval.

rival

(verb). sánh với, cạnh tranh với

Ex: You will find scenery to rival anything you can see in the Alps.

sector

(noun). khu vực

Ex: We have seen rapid growth in the services sector.

temporary

(adjective). Tạm thời

Ex: The ceasefire will only provide a temporary solution to the crisis.

ultimately

(adverb). cuối cùng

Ex: A poor diet will ultimately lead to illness.

utilization

(noun). sự tận dụng

Ex: Sensible utilization of the world's resources is a priority.

society

(noun). xã hội

Ex: Every section of society must have access to education.

corporation

(noun). tập đoàn

Ex: She didn't want to work for a big corporation where everything was so impersonal.

essential

(adjective). thiết yếu

Ex: The local government is not able to provide essential services such as gas, water and electricity.

workforce

(noun). Lực lượng lao động

Ex: Companies are under pressure to hire a more diverse workforce.

attract

(verb). thu hút

Ex: This proposal has attracted a lot of interest.

consumer

(noun). Người tiêu dùng

Ex: Health-conscious consumers want more information about the food they buy.

anticipate

(verb). Dự đoán

Ex: We anticipate that sales will rise next year.

bankrupt

(verb). làm phá sản

Ex: The company was almost bankrupted by legal costs.

evidence

(noun). Bằng chứng

Ex: Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.

evolve

(verb). Tiến hoá

Ex: The three species evolved from a single ancestor.

firm

(noun). hãng, công ty

Ex: She works for a firm of management consultants based in London.

illustrate

(verb). Minh hoạ

Ex: He is showing these silent films to help illustrate his story of survival.

liable

(adjective). có trách nhiệm pháp lý

Ex: You will be liable for any damage caused.

monitor

(verb). GIám sát

Ex: The nurse is monitoring his heart rate and respiration.

mount

(verb). tăng dần

Ex: Pressure is mounting on the government to change the law.

outcome

(noun). Kết quả

Ex: We are confident of a positive outcome.

progress

(verb). tiến triển, phát triển

Ex: The course allows students to progress at their own speed.

risk

(noun). rủi ro

Ex: The health risks are very low.

survival

(noun). sự sinh tồn, sự sống sót

Ex: Exporting is necessary for our economic survival.

identify

(verb). Xác định, nhận dạng

Ex: They are trying to identify what is wrong with the present system.

intersect

(verb). giao nhau

Ex: We need to pinpoint the place where maximum achievable conservation intersects with the highest potential financial return.

present

(verb). đưa ra, bày ra

Ex: Are you presenting a paper at the conference?

resolve

(verb). giải quyết

Ex: Attempts are being made to resolve the problem of security in schools.

select

(verb). chọn lọc

Ex: He hasn't been selected for the team.

administrator

(noun). quản trị viên

Ex: Such organizational decisions are made by the hospital administrators.

citizenship

(noun). Quốc tịch, tư cách công dân

Ex: You can apply for citizenship after five years' residency.

contribute

(verb). đóng góp

Ex: We contributed £5 000 to the earthquake fund.

direct

(adjective). trực tiếp

Ex: Clinical depression is thought to have a direct link to brain chemistry.

donation

(noun). sự quyên góp

Ex: The work of the charity is funded by voluntary donations.

gain

(noun). lợi ích

Ex: These policies have resulted in great gains in public health.

goal

(noun). Mục đích, mục tiêu

Ex: My job is to help businesses meet their goals.

goodwill

(noun). thiện chí

Ex: He expressed goodwill towards his former colleagues.

incidental

(adjective). ngẫu nhiên, tình cờ

Ex: The discovery was incidental to their main research.

involve

(verb). liên quan, bao hàm

Ex: The test will involve answering questions about a photograph.

limit

(verb). giới hạn

Ex: The amount of money you have to spend will limit your choice.

modest

(adjective). khiêm tốn, vừa phải

Ex: He charged a relatively modest fee.

rate

(noun). Tỷ lệ

Ex: We have seen a reduction in the crime rate over the last 12 months.

remain

(verb). vẫn, giữ như cũ

Ex: Train fares are likely to remain unchanged.

specify

(verb). Chỉ rõ, định rõ

Ex: Remember to specify your size when ordering clothes.

track

(verb). Theo dõi tiến độ

Ex: The research project involves tracking the careers of 400 graduates.

initiative

(noun). Kiến nghị, sáng kiến

Ex: Most policy initiatives come from the White House.

adopt

(verb). Thông qua, lựa chọn

Ex: All three teams adopted different approaches to the problem.

achieve

(verb). Đạt được, giành được

Ex: He had finally achieved success.

constraint

(noun). sự hạn chế

Ex: This decision will impose serious constraints on all schools.

expand

(verb). Mở rộng

Ex: A child's vocabulary expands through reading.

partnership

(noun). Quan hệ hợp tác

Ex: He developed his own program in partnership with an American expert.

shortage

(noun). sự thiếu

Ex: There's a shortage of food and shelter in the refugee camps.

major

(adjective). chủ yếu, quan trọng

Ex: He played a major role in setting up the system.

aim

(verb). nhắm vào, hướng vào

Ex: The government is aiming at a 50% reduction in unemployment.

aspect

(noun). Khía cạnh

Ex: The book aims to cover all aspects of city life.

commitment

(noun). sự cam kết

Ex: Players must make a commitment to play for a full season.

construct

(verb). xây dựng

Ex: You must learn how to construct a logical argument.

dimension

(noun). chiều

Ex: Her job added a new dimension to her life.

distinguish

(verb). phân biệt

Ex: At what age are children able to distinguish between right and wrong?

extend

(verb). mở rộng

Ex: The company plans to extend its operations into Europe.

proposition

(noun). đề xuất

Ex: I'd like to put a business proposition to you.

raw

(adjective). thô, chưa tinh chế

Ex: Oil is an important raw material that can be processed into many different products, including plastics.

reinforce

(verb). Củng cố, tăng cường

Ex: Success in the talks will reinforce his reputation as an international statesman.

strategy

(noun). Chiến thuật

Ex: Follow this strategy for avoiding minor mistakes.

unique

(adjective). đặc biệt, độc nhất

Ex: Everyone's fingerprints are unique.

customer

(noun). khách hàng

Ex: They know me—I'm a regular customer.

emphasize

(verb). Nhấn mạnh

Ex: His speech emphasized the importance of attracting industry to the town.

internally

(adverb). bên trong

Ex: The party is deeply divided internally.

purchase

(noun). sự mua, vật mua được

Ex: If you are not satisfied with your purchase, we will give you a full refund.

equal

(adjective). bằng nhau, ngang hàng

Ex: The two countries are roughly equal in size.

productivity

(noun). hiệu suất

Ex: Wage rates depend on levels of productivity.

impose

(verb). áp đặt

Ex: The government has imposed a ban on the sale of handguns.

integral

(adjective). cần thiết

Ex: Music is an integral part of the school's curriculum.

restriction

(noun). sự hạn chế

Ex: The government has agreed to lift restrictions on press freedom.

treat

(verb). đối xử

Ex: My parents still treat me like a child.

unfairly

(adverb). không công bằng, bất công

Ex: She believes she's being unfairly criticized.

workplace

(noun). nơi làm việc

Ex: We must meet safety standards in the workplace

composting

(noun). sự ủ phân

Ex: There should be more composting of garden and food waste.

disposable

(adjective). dùng một lần

Ex: Maybe I shouldn't have used cheap disposable razors.

regional

(adjective). thuộc vùng miền

Ex: This issue affects regional security and has international implications.

waste

(noun). Rác rưởi, đồ thải, thức ăn thừa

Ex: household/garden/industrial waste Ex: Landfills for solid wastes have started reaching their capacity.

common

(adjective). chung, phổ biến

Ex:They share a common interest in photography.

contain

(verb). Chứa đựng, bao gồm

Ex: This drink doesn't contain any alcohol.

damaging

(adjective). Có hại

Ex: Smoking is damaging to health.

goods

(noun). hàng hóa

Ex: The goods will be delivered within ten days.

ingredient

(noun). Thành phần, nguyên liệu

Ex: Our skin cream contains only natural ingredients.

procurement

(noun). sự kiếm được

Ex: She has responsibility for the procurement of equipment in the company.

facility

(noun). Cơ sở vật chất

Ex: The school is upgrading its outdoor play facilities.

ensure

(verb). Đảm bảo

Ex: We are working to ensure the safety of people in the city.

faculty

(noun). khoa

Ex: We are in a shrinking market as colleges and universities downsize their agricultural faculties.

professional

(adjective). chuyên nghiệp

Ex: She always looks very professional in her smart suits.

systematic

(adjective). Có hệ thống

Ex: None of the studies were sufficiently systematic to give a reliable result.

up to date

(adjective). hiện đại

Ex: We'll have to bring our equipment up to date.

sections.title: Passage 3: The Significant Role of Mother Tongue in Education
sections.html:
adolescent

(noun). thiếu niên

Ex: She doesn't understand the emotional problems of adolescents.

chasm

(noun). cách biệt lớn

Ex: A chasm separates my generation from my parents'.

consequence

(noun). Hậu quả

Ex: Remember that actions have consequences.

diversity

(noun). sự đa dạng

Ex: There is a need for greater diversity and choice in education.

division

(noun). sự phân chia, sự chia rẽ

Ex: There are deep divisions in the party over the war.

established

(adjective). có uy tín

Ex: They are an established company with a good reputation.

evolution

(noun). sự tiến hoá

Ex: Evolution requires intermediate forms between species.

extend

(verb). mở rộng

Ex: The company plans to extend its operations into Europe.

extensively

(adverb). 1 cách bao quát

Ex: He has written extensively on contemporary art.

flexibility

(noun). Tính linh hoạt

Ex: The new system offers a much greater degree of flexibility in the way work is organized.

identify

(verb). Xác định, nhận dạng

Ex: They are trying to identify what is wrong with the present system.

implement

(verb). thi hành, thực hiện

Ex: A new work programme for young people will be implemented.

integration

(noun). sự hội nhập, sự hòa nhập

Ex: He has arranged many activities to promote national integration among his students.

intellectual

(adjective). Về mặt trí tuệ

Ex: It can be very difficult to measure intellectual ability.

latter

(noun). cái sau

Ex: He presented two solutions. The latter seems much better.

mainstream

(adjective). đại chúng

Ex: This is the director's first mainstream Hollywood film.

mobility

(noun). tính lưu động

Ex: The high cost of living acts as an obstacle to mobility of labour.

nurture

(verb). nuôi dưỡng

Ex: It's important to nurture a good working relationship.

permit

(verb). Cho phép

Ex: Mobile phones are not permitted in the examination room.

predictor

(noun). người dự đoán, điều dự đoán

Ex: Cholesterol level is not a strong predictor of heart disease in women.

process

(verb). xử lí, hiểu

Ex: My brain slowly processed the fact that I was free to leave.

progress

(verb). tiến triển, phát triển

Ex: The course allows students to progress at their own speed.

significant

(adjective). Đáng lưu ý, quan trọng

Ex: There are no significant differences between the two groups of students.

threaten

(verb). đe dọa

Ex: Pollution is threatening marine life.

unfortunate

(adjective). đáng tiếc

Ex: It was unfortunate that he couldn't speak English.

appropriate

(adjective). Phù hợp

Ex: Is now an appropriate time to make a speech?

contribution

(noun). sự đóng góp

Ex: a significant contribution to scientific knowledge Ex: He made a very positive contribution to the success of the project.

discourage

(verb). làm nản lòng

Ex: His parents tried to discourage him from being an actor.

linguistically

(adverb). thuộc về ngôn ngữ

Ex: Silicon Valley has become one of the most linguistically diverse places in America.

maximise

(verb). cực đại hoá

Ex: The company is seeking to maximize its productivity.

resource

(noun). Nguồn tài nguyên

Ex: They promote the use of renewable resources like soybean oil.

waste

(verb). Lãng phí

Ex: His talents are wasted in that job.

wealth

(noun). Sự giàu có

Ex: During a successful business career, she accumulated a great amount of wealth.

mother tongue

(noun). tiếng mẹ đẻ

Ex: Many immigrants not only learn English in addition to their mother tongue, but also speak other languages.

valuable

(adjective). quý giá

Ex: You should gain some valuable insights into the world of business.

bilingual

(adjective). sử dụng 2 thứ tiếng

Ex: She is bilingual in English and French.

conduct

(verb). tiến hành

Ex: Police conducted a thorough search of the building.

lend weight to

(verb). tăng ảnh hưởng, tăng sức nặng

Ex: This latest evidence lends weight to her theory.

philosopher

(noun). nhà triết học

Ex: We studied the writings of the Greek philosopher Aristotle.

refer to

(verb). đề cập, nhắc đến

Ex: The victims were not referred to by name.

truly

(adverb). đích thực, thực sự

Ex: The results are truly amazing.

ability

(noun). khả năng, năng lực

Ex: People with the disease may lose their ability to communicate.

effectively

(adverb). một cách hiệu quả

Ex: Managers must be able to work effectively in a cooperative setting.

gain

(verb). đạt được, giành được

Ex: As you gain experience, you will grow in confidence.

research

(noun). nghiên cứu

Ex: His researches in the field of disease prevention produced unexpected results.

concept

(noun). khái niệm, ý tưởng

Ex: the concept that everyone should have equality of opportunity

firm

(adjective). chắc chắn

Ex: This book will give your students a firm grasp of English grammar.

foundation

(noun). nền tảng

Ex: Respect and friendship provide a solid foundation for marriage.

grasp

(noun). sự nắm được, sự hiểu thấu

Ex: He has a good grasp of German grammar.

solid

(adjective). chắc chắn

Ex: His advice was always solid and practical.

literacy

(noun). trình độ học vấn

Ex: All the children are tested in basic literacy.

fear

(verb). sợ, lo ngại, e ngại

Ex: It was feared that unemployment could rise.

suspicious

(adjective). hoài nghi

Ex: They became suspicious of his behaviour and contacted the police.

majority

(noun). phần đa số

Ex: The majority of people interviewed prefer TV to radio.

catch up with

(verb). theo kịp

Ex: After missing a term through illness, he had to work hard to catch up with the others.

converse

(verb). trò chuyện

Ex: The two men were conversing on music and opera.

marvel

(verb). Trầm trồ ngạc nhiên

Ex: Everyone marvelled at his courage.

record

(verb). ghi chép, ghi nhận

Ex: Unemployment is likely to reach the highest total that has ever been recorded.

remarkable

(adjective). đáng chú ý, đặc biệt

Ex: He adapted to the new situation with remarkable speed.

acquire

(verb). nhận được, đạt được

Ex: She has acquired a good knowledge of English.

aware

(adjective). Có nhận thức

Ex: They suddenly became aware of people looking at them.

context

(noun). Bối cảnh

Ex: Such databases are being used in a wide range of contexts.

disappear

(verb). biến mất

Ex: Wildlife is fast disappearing from our countryside.

similar

(adjective). tương tự

Ex: The forest was similar but there was a trail I followed for a time

according to

(preposition). theo

Ex: The salary will be fixed according to qualifications and experience.

background

(noun). Lý lịch, xuất thân, nền tảng phía sau...

Ex: The job would suit someone with a business background.

certain

(adjective). nhất định, nào đó

Ex: You can choose to only watch certain kinds of movies.

concentration

(noun). Mật độ

Ex: Evaporation gradually increases the salt concentration of the water.

extent

(noun). Mức độ

Ex: To a certain extent, we are all responsible for this tragic situation.

linguistic

(adjective). liên quan đến ngôn ngữ

Ex: I'm particularly interested in the linguistic development of young children.

loss

(noun). mất mát

Ex: He suffered a loss of confidence.

phenomenon

(noun). hiện tượng

Ex: Globalization is a phenomenon of the 21st century.

proposition

(noun). đề xuất

Ex: I'd like to put a business proposition to you.

rapidity

(noun). sự nhanh chóng

Ex: The disease is spreading with alarming rapidity.

settle

(verb). định cư, ổn điịnh cuộc sống

Ex: He has now settled permanently in London.

vary

(verb). Thay đổi, khác nhau

Ex: The students' work varies considerably in quality.

community

(noun). cộng đồng

Ex: The local community supported us from the start.

concentrate

(verb). tập trung

Ex: Power is largely concentrated in the hands of a small elite.

employ

(verb). sử dụng

Ex: The police had to employ force to enter the building.

limit

(verb). giới hạn

Ex: The amount of money you have to spend will limit your choice.

peer

(noun). bạn đồng trang lứa

Ex: Children are worried about failing in front of their peers.

receptive

(adjective). tiếp thu

Ex: She was always receptive to new ideas.

retain

(verb). Giữ lại

Ex: He struggled to retain control of the situation.

sibling

(noun). anh chị em ruột

Ex: I have four siblings: three brothers and a sister.

alienate

(verb). làm cho xa lánh

Ex: His comments have alienated a lot of young voters.

aspect

(noun). Khía cạnh

Ex: The book aims to cover all aspects of city life.

circumstance

(noun). Hoàn cảnh, tình huống

Ex: I know I can trust her in any circumstance.

dislocation

(noun). Sự làm hỏng, sự làm trục trặc

Ex: These policies could cause severe economic and social dislocation.

frequently

(adverb). thường xuyên

Ex: It was a word he used frequently.

relation

(noun). mối quan hệ

Ex: Little of what he said has any relation to fact.

predictable

(adjective). có thể đoán trước được

Ex: The ending of the book was entirely predictable.

attend

(verb). tham dự, có mặt

Ex: Everyone is welcome to attend the free event.

kindergarten

(noun). Trường mẫu giáo

Ex: She teaches reading to students in kindergarten.

usual

(adjective). thường, thường thấy

Ex: This weather is not usual for this time of year.

illustrate

(verb). Minh hoạ

Ex: He is showing these silent films to help illustrate his story of survival.

adverse

(adjective). Bất lợi, có hại

Ex: Taxes are having an adverse effect on production.

host

(noun). chủ nhà

Ex: Japan is playing host to the next international conference.

prove

(verb). Chứng minh

Ex: She was determined to prove everyone wrong.

accept

(verb). chấp nhận

Ex: He asked me to marry him and I accepted.

advanced

(adjective). hiện đại, nâng cao

Ex: Sweden has a reputation for advanced and stylish design.

comprehension

(noun). sự hiểu, sự nhận thức

Ex: She has no comprehension of the seriousness of the situation.

distinguish

(verb). phân biệt

Ex: At what age are children able to distinguish between right and wrong?

strategy

(noun). Chiến thuật

Ex: Follow this strategy for avoiding minor mistakes.

transfer

(verb). chuyển đổi

Ex: The novel does not transfer well to the movies.
